closureCriteria: A ROUTE-009 or ROUTE-010 ownership change must be backed by new pinned task/path evidence rather than residual set arithmetic.

The candidate must have task-specific source, direct caller, direct test and genuine specification evidence with explicit inputs, outputs, failure semantics, state/resource lifetime and bounded authority.

The candidate must exclude all locally implemented and frozen routing ownership above and must not require hidden JS runtime, credentials, user-DB mutation, network, UI/browser state, process environment mutation or an unapproved dependency.
Every unresolved partition must be assigned by source-grounded decomposition or remain explicitly blocked; no singleton surface is sufficient by itself.
